counts.newResponses: {count, plural, one {# new application} other {# new applications}}

dashboard.title: My jobs
dashboard.verifyWhat: your jobs will not be sent for review
dashboard.sent: The job has been sent for review. This usually takes up to one business day.
dashboard.emptyText: Create your first one: add the salary range, tech stack and responsibilities. After review it will appear in search, and applications will land here.

billing.title: Plan
billing.noLimits: no limits on the number of jobs or applications
billing.text: While the platform is growing, posting is free. When paid options arrive, they will only affect job promotion; basic posting will stay free for existing companies.

company.title: Company
company.introExisting: This information is shown on job cards and on the company page.
company.introNew: Fill in the company profile to start posting jobs.

form.name: Name
form.aboutHint: Two or three sentences: what you do and what the team is like

responses.title: Applications
responses.emptyText: They will show up as soon as a published job catches the interest of job seekers.

vacancyForm.newIntro: Fill in the card. After review the job will appear in search and get its own link.
vacancyForm.statusPublished: The job is published. Changes apply as soon as you save.
vacancyForm.statusModeration: The job is in review. You can keep editing; the latest version will be reviewed.
vacancyForm.statusRejected: The job was rejected in review. Fix it and submit again.
vacancyForm.statusRejectedWithComment: The job was rejected in review: {comment}. Fix it and submit again.

fields.title: Job title
fields.titleHint: Role and key technology. No "urgent" or exclamation marks.
fields.salaryNote: Required: jobs without a salary range are not published on the platform.
fields.skillsHint: For example: Go, PostgreSQL, Kafka, Kubernetes. At least three.
fields.requirementsHint: Only what the work cannot be done without. Put wishes under "nice to have"
fields.conditionsHint: Contract type, health insurance, equipment, training
fields.acceptsGithubLink: Accept applications with a GitHub link instead of a resume
fields.showCompanyName: Show the company name on the card

preview.title: How the card looks in search

checks.title: Pre-publish check
checks.draftHint: A draft can be saved in any state; it goes to review only after all checks pass.
checks.titleMin: Job title of at least 8 characters
checks.salaryMissing: Salary range missing: we do not publish without it
checks.stackOk: Tech stack filled in, at least 3 technologies
checks.sectionsOk: "What you will do" and "what matters" are filled in
checks.sectionsEmpty: "What you will do" and "what matters" are empty
checks.discriminatory: Looks like age or gender requirements: they are prohibited by employment law

tariff.placeholder: [PLAN TERMS: posting price, listing duration, number of applications]

applications.emptyPublished: The job is live in search; applications will appear here.
applications.emptyUnpublished: The job is not published, so job seekers cannot see it.

errors.salaryRange: The lower bound of the range is higher than the upper bound
errors.verifyEmail: Confirm your email to submit the job for review: use the link in the email, or request it again on the "My jobs" page
errors.websiteProtocol: The website must start with http:// or https://
